result.summary: Play develops down the right wing as the team in white builds out against the green press, working the ball inside to advance through central midfield.

observations.title: Build-up into the right touchline
observations.body: The white team circulates possession out to the right flank under pressure from green midfielders. The receiving player holds position near the touchline to provide an outlet.

observations.title: Recycling inside away from pressure
observations.body: Facing pressure along the sideline, the wide player checks back and connects with the central midfielder. This switch inward bypasses the initial recovery line of the defending team.

observations.title: Central carry into attacking half
observations.body: The central midfielder drives forward into vacated space between the defensive lines. Forward runners adjust their paths toward the box to stretch the retreating back line.
